1.0.0.note: published as released and not modified

1.0.1.note: licensing clarification in section 32, no normative contract change

1.0.2.note: published as released and not modified

1.0.3.note: documentation, packaging and developer-experience release; no normative contract change; contract fingerprints identical to 1.0.2

1.0.4.note: hygiene release; no normative contract change; contract fingerprints identical to 1.0.3; conformance result satisfies section 26; official Foundation conformance suite repaired and now executed by the release gate; Foundation and Compiled Runtime boundary corrected in the public material

1.1.0.note: independent-implementability release; adds governedResultHash and schemas/1.1.0/compiled-context.schema.json; artifactHash meaning unchanged; the 1.0.0 contract surface stays frozen and byte-identical across 1.0.0 to 1.1.0

1.1.1.note: maintenance release; no normative contract change; resolves the section 14.3 line-ending ambiguity so the Python and JavaScript canonicalisers agree on object keys; states the context id rule, the asOf representation and the requiresDefined element-id rule; corrects release metadata drift and hardens the release gate against it

1.1.2.note: maintenance release; no normative contract change; states the section 14.3b string escape set and the section 14.0 validity-window element set, both recording measured 1.1.1 behaviour; corrects the version stamps and the rewritten 1.1.0 changelog history; adds four release-gate guards

1.1.3.note: maintenance release; no normative contract change; section 10.2a makes a hard conflict fail a target only when the subject is decision-relevant to it; section 14.3 step 3 states UTF-16 code-unit ordering and names ECMAScript enumeration order as explicitly not it; section 14.3a states that projection policies must not change the resolved selection; the cross-language vectors carry expected output and are usable as a standalone oracle; every current-release surface corrected and gate-checked

1.1.6.note: hardening release; one normative addition, section 14.3c, which pins the Unicode version governing canonical NFC and admits only code points assigned in it plus the permanent noncharacters; section 8.0a states canonical identity for element id and semantic subject; section 11.5 resolves elementValueRef through the governed selection instead of the raw manifest snapshot; section 10.2a states that its concrete list reads the rule rather than narrowing it and counts a RULE that would add requirements or checks, and an element the target declares eligible guidance; the half-open validity boundary is now proved by tests that execute the implementation at the exact instants, and the release gate runs them

2.0.0.note: interchange correction; MAJOR under section 27.1 because it rejects governed YAML forms 1.x accepted; section 28.1 pins how governed YAML is read, so the same bytes can no longer produce two governed values and two canonical hashes; section 26.2 conformance evidence now names executed cases the release gate resolves against the run it performs itself; section 14.3a is aligned with the decision-relevant conflict semantics of section 10.2a; no new Brand State, profile, capability or architecture
